k-sym-GTA6.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launch coins
k-sym-GTA6.sourceSays: Posts say Rockstar Games' GTA VI launches Nov 19 with pre-loading open, and one account says GTA VI-themed memecoins are already among crypto's hottest narratives.
k-sym-GTA6.reason: Rockstar's official Nov 12 post gives the Nov 19 release; a Nov 2 post describes GTA VI memecoins as a narrative. The three $GTA6 pools opened under an hour ago, so they launched into the hype; they are copycat tickers (an older $GTA6 coin is cited in posts).
